title: GPT-5 and GPT-5 mini will be retired on December 11, 2026
body: OpenAI GPT-5 and OpenAI GPT-5 mini will be retired on December 11, 2026. OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol is the recommended replacement for GPT-5, and OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is the recommended replacement for GPT-5 mini. See [Legacy, deprecated, and retired models](/aws/en/machine-learning/retired-models-policy#retired) for migration guidance.
